notes:
## Maps
### Trawler
- The sea is water now: fall overboard and you float and can swim.
- Swimming and treading water tire you out. Run out of stamina and you sink and are out; back on deck it recovers.
- Jump in the water to lunge up and grab the boat.
- Grab someone in the water from above and you push them under. Held under, they run out of breath fast and drown.
### Rooftop
- The skylight pit kills again.
### Incinerator
- Brighter.
## Champions
### Sylas
- Abscond trails his fists, and E lights up while Abduct's recast is ready.

## Champions
### Sylas
- Abduct (E recast): within 3s of Abscond, press E again to throw both chains at your cursor. The first champ they hit is stopped dead, and Sylas flies to them and knocks them back. Abscond still empowers your next punch.
- Abscond (E) is just a dash: it no longer bumps whoever you run into.
## Gameplay
- Punches are hooks: the elbow swings out and round, and the forearm straightens on contact.
- Punches fly at the target's head, and auto-aim reaches 1.5m.
- Each hand punches once a second; alternate hands for two a second.
- Every punch dazes the same for every champ, empowered ones too: 5 punches knock out. Only an extremely fast fist hits harder.
- A punch clicked while that hand is busy is kept and thrown the moment it's free, and the arm no longer jerks back mid-swing.
- After a punch the arm eases back down instead of dropping, and the chest stops wobbling.
- Turning while punching no longer spins you right round or twists your legs backwards: a reversal swings round through the front.
- Heads bobble loosely on the neck.
- Lift throws send everyone the same distance (about 2m); a perfectly timed release no longer flings twice as far.
- Five new laughs, and only one fall laugh plays at a time, 5s apart.
## Online play
- Your own dashes, charges, spins and slams (Headbutt, Pulverize, Rampage, Abscond, Haymaker, Flay, Fling and more) play the moment you press them, in the order you pressed them. Alistar E then Q no longer has Q overtake E.
- Taking back control of your champ after being moved by the host eases in instead of jumping.
## Interface
- Mac version (Intel and Apple Silicon): download the .dmg from the release page. It offers each new version at launch.
- Practice: fighting dummies brawl with everyone, picking a new foe every few seconds.
## Fixes
- Pulverize plays one slam sound instead of a hit sound per champ it launches.
*Everyone needs 1.20.0 to play together.*

## Champions
### Sylas
- Abscond (E) dashes the way you face again, not toward your cursor.
## Gameplay
- Punches knock back 80% less: trade blows toe to toe instead of batting each other out of reach.
- Each hand can punch twice a second; alternate hands to keep up four a second.
## Online play
- With a high ping, follow-up punches register: a second punch at someone the first had already knocked back on the host was counted as a push. Each punch now lands as hard as it did on your screen.
- Own Abscond and other dashes no longer snap forward at the end (since 1.19.0).
*Everyone needs 1.19.1 to play together.*

## Champions
### Sylas (new)
- Hijack (Q): hold to aim, and the champ you'd take glows. Let go and his chain lashes out to them and steals their Q. Missing costs nothing. The stolen Q replaces Hijack, ready to cast right away, until you are knocked out.
- Abscond (E): a short dash toward your cursor that bumps whoever you hit. For 4s your next punch whirls him round and strikes everyone around your target.
- Look: chained shackles on both wrists that swing as you move and crackle with lightning while Abscond's punch is ready.
## Maps
- Rooftop: knocked off the building, you fall for about 2 seconds before you're out (was under 1), time to grab the edge or a friend.
## Online play
- The host sends 60 updates a second (was 30), packed into far fewer bytes: everyone else shows up about 30ms sooner, for about the same upload.
- The end of a dash, charge or pull no longer snaps you forward: you ease back into your own movement.
- The first seconds of each round no longer show everyone extra far behind (loading the match was read as a bad connection).
- Knocked out, carried by a move, or in Server only: your own champ shows the host's latest a little sooner.
- The host's game runs on its own clock instead of its screen's frames: updates reach everyone at a steady pace even when the host's frame rate dips.
- Server only setting (Settings and the Esc menu): your champ moves only when the host says so. A round trip late, but never corrected.
## Interface
- Practice: choose how many dummies (0-7) and which champion each one plays, or Random.
- Practice: dummies can fight back, from the Practice tab or the Esc menu.
*Everyone needs 1.19.0 to play together.*

## Fixes
- Loading into a map no longer freezes the game for a few seconds (shaders are now prepared in the background before the map is shown).

## Maps
- Subway: Gang Beasts' trains run both tracks, one each way, every 4-30 seconds, with their engine sound. Get caught on the track and the train carries you into the tunnel and you're out. Walking deep enough into a tunnel puts you out too.
*Everyone needs 1.18.0 to play together.*

## Champions
### Thresh
- New look: a black V-shaped jacket with a sharp collar and a key on a chain, three sectioned dreads, and his lantern on his hip (no longer under his hand).
- Death Sentence (Q) throws a real hook: a curved blade on a chain.
- Death Sentence tugs twice: one pull, a 0.5s pause, then a second pull.
- Flay (E) knocks everyone in the line the way you aim: away from you in front, toward you behind. It knocks them much higher and less far.
## Interface
- Practice: Esc opens the pause menu, where you can switch champion right away (leave from there).
*The host needs 1.17.0 for the Thresh changes.*

## Fixes
- Joining someone else's match no longer freezes the game at the start (broken in 1.16.5).
## Interface
- Patch notes have a clearer layout: sections, a heading per champion, and a bullet per change.

## Champions
### Thresh
- Flay (E) works like League's: everyone in the line is knocked a short way back, away from your cursor. Aim at them to pull them in, aim away to push them off. No more throwing them over you.
- Flay's indicator is as wide as it hits, with arrows showing which way it knocks.
### Lee Sin
- Dragon's Rage (E) knocks them up as well as back.
## Online play
- Your own punches, cast animations, windups and their indicators play the moment you press, instead of a round trip later. The host still decides what hits.
- Vi's and Sett's Q windup indicators no longer snap around at high ping.
- Sent flying by a hit, you follow the host's flight instead of teleporting about mid-air.
*The host needs 1.16.5 for the Thresh and Lee Sin changes.*

## Champions
### Lee Sin
- Sonic Wave (Q): cooldown 6s (was 8s), and the flying kick knocks back 15% further.
- Dragon's Rage (E) knocks back 25% further and reaches 15% further.
### Vi
- Vault Breaker (Q) winds up 25% faster (full power in 0.94s) and dashes 35% further.
- Relentless Force (E) knocks back 25% further, cooldown 3s (was 4s).
### Sett
- Haymaker (Q): the hard-hitting strip down the middle of the cone is 25% wider.
## Gameplay
- Knockouts last 25% shorter (2.4s, was 3.2s).
- Dizzy stars only show while you are knocked out.
## Maps
- Rooftop is now the first stage and the default for new lobbies.
## Online play
- Punches, headbutts and dashes now land where you saw your target, like abilities: high-ping players no longer swing at thin air.
- The host makes up for up to 0.4s of lag (was 0.25s), so abilities land at higher ping too.
- Your own abilities, arms and hook show up as soon as the host confirms them, instead of an extra delay on top of your ping.
- No more getting yanked forward after casting an ability, getting knocked out, hooked or let go of.
*The host needs 1.16.4 for the hit fixes.*

## Champions
### Lee Sin
- Dragon's Rage (E) reaches a third further.
### Hecarim
- Devastating Charge (E) gets to full gallop in 1s (was 1.5s).
### Sett
- Haymaker (Q) winds up 25% faster: full power in 1.2s (was 1.5s), and knocks them a little up as well as back.
## Gameplay
- Grabbing someone knocked down on the floor is much easier: hold grab near them and your hands go for them, bending down if they are lying down, and latch on instead of grabbing the floor.
- If the last players fall off within half a second of each other, the round is a draw.
## Interface
- Chat in the lobby.
- The host can kick players.
- Everyone sees their ping and frame rate in a match (the host sees 0 ms); dev mode adds the rest.
- Patch notes: after an update the menu shows what changed since the version you last played (also under Patch notes in the menu).

## Champions
### Lee Sin
- Dragon's Rage (E) knocks back 50% harder.
- The Sonic Wave (Q) recast kick knocks back 25% less.
### Singed
- Fling (E) grabs from 25% further away.
## Online play
- Players in China connect to online games through a faster route when one is available.

## Gameplay
- After getting up from a knockout you are untouchable for 1 second (no hits, grabs or hooks) and drawn see-through.
- New laughs mixed in with the Gang Beasts ones.

## Champions
### Lee Sin (new)
- Sonic Wave (Q) marks the first champ it hits for 3s; press Q again to fly in with a flying kick and knock them back. The cooldown starts once the mark is used or wears off, and the Q slot glows while you can recast.
- Dragon's Rage (E) is a roundhouse kick that knocks the champ in front back into anyone behind them.
## Fixes
- Online, your champion now turns to face where you aim instead of its arms bending backwards.

## Gameplay
- Climbing like Gang Beasts: holding jump while hanging lifts you up to your hands and stops there, legs hanging (no more gliding up walls).
- Move while hanging to swing your legs, up and over your head; swing them over a ledge and let go to climb onto it.
- Let go of one hand and it reaches back up: grab again to climb hand over hand.
- Jumps go 25% higher.
## Maps
- Trawler and Subway are lit like Gang Beasts, with its sky and ambient light.
- Subway: the camera sits closer, at Gang Beasts' angle; a stray copy of the station is gone.
## Online play
- Blitz's and Vi's E now glow on your own screen when you join someone's lobby.
*Everyone needs 1.15.1 to play together.*

## Gameplay
- Punch aim assist: punches turn to the nearest enemy in front of you, like Gang Beasts.
- Sprint is slower (4.8 m/s).
## Maps
- New: Trawler, a fishing boat out at sea. Throw them overboard, or down the hold.
- New: Subway, an underground platform between two tracks.
## Online play
- Gang Beasts' netcode: your walking, jumping and sprinting are instant; punches, grabs, abilities and dashes are the host's, so everyone sees the same fight even at high ping.
- Abilities land where you saw your target (the host makes up for your lag).
- Cooldowns come back on time at high ping.
*Everyone needs 1.15.0 to play together.*

## Online play
- Much smoother play on high ping or a bad connection: other players keep moving through lag spikes instead of freezing and then jumping.
- Your own champion gets yanked back far less when your connection stalls.
- The game sends half as much data.
- Better connections get more responsive play too: other players are shown fresher and your inputs reach the host sooner.
## Interface
- Your ping is shown top left in a match.
- Dev mode: the ping line also shows fps, the slowest frame and how far behind other players are drawn.

## Champions
### Singed
- Fling throws 30% further.
## Online play
- Smoother movement of other players for anyone connected through the relay.

## Champions
### Singed
- Glue now lands where your cursor is, even right under you, with a range and target indicator.
### Blitzcrank
- Rocket Grab leaves its target stunned on their feet (dizzy stars) for 0.5s.
### Sett
- Facebreaker can stop a dash (like Vi's Q) if you time it.
### Vi
- Vault Breaker (Q) is 15% weaker.
### Alistar
- Headbutt knockback is 25% shorter again.
## Gameplay
- Running: double-tap a movement key and keep holding it.
- Knocked-out champs slide around more easily.

## Champions
### Thresh
- Flay hits both sides of him, with a two-sided aim indicator: aim at enemies to throw them behind you, aim away to push them off.
### Blitzcrank
- Rocket Grab leaves its target limp for 0.5s after the pull.
### Alistar
- Headbutt knockback is 25% shorter.
### Hecarim
- Rampage cooldown is 3s (was 4s).
## Interface
- Abilities show as disabled while you're stuck in Singed's glue.

## Champions
### Thresh
- The hook now holds its target helpless for the whole chain, and pressing Q again flies you all the way to them.
- New look: soul-fire head, iron shoulders and chains.
### Singed
- Glue only affects enemies, and stops them using abilities while they're in it.

## Champions
### Thresh (new)
- Death Sentence (Q) hooks a champ, tugs them toward you and chains you together for 2s (press Q again to leap to them).
- Flay (E) throws everyone in a line over and behind you.
### Singed (new)
- Mega Adhesive (Q) lobs a glue puddle that slows champs and stops them jumping.
- Fling (E) throws the champ next to you over your head.

## Champions
### Alistar
- Headbutt: hold E to aim it with your mouse, let go to lunge that way.

## Champions
### Alistar (new)
- Pulverize (Q) launches everyone around him.
- Headbutt (E) knocks a champ far back, much further if they're still in the air.
### Hecarim
- Knockback +25%.
## Online play
- Much less rubber-banding, especially on long-distance or lossy connections.
- Players who can't connect directly now get a fast relay.
- Holding each other no longer makes you float.
## Interface
- Switch champion from the Esc menu (takes effect next round).

## Champions
### Sett
- Haymaker (Q): +50% power, and punches can no longer interrupt the windup (only a knockout can).
### Hecarim
- Devastating Charge (E): no aim indicator; press to charge, press again to stop.
## Online play
- Grabbing another player no longer rubber-bands, floats or teleports.
- Smoother movement on 120-200 ms connections.

## Champions
### Vi
- Vault Breaker (Q): once fully wound up you can hold it for 3 more seconds.
## Gameplay
- Practice: you no longer respawn on top of someone.
## Maps
- Gang Beasts stages (Girders, Rooftop, Incinerator) run about twice as fast.
## Online play
- Fixed bouncing in and out of the floor (and falling through it) when playing in someone else's lobby with high ping.
- Lobby codes are now 3 characters.
## Interface
- In-match chat: press T (rebindable in Controls), Enter to send, Esc to cancel.
*Everyone needs 1.9.0 to play together.*

## Champions
### Sett
- Haymaker (Q) reworked, no more Grit: hold Q to lock your aim at the cursor and wind up. The longer you hold, the further (2-5 m) and harder it hits. Everyone sees the cone fill. Catches champs right beside him; a miss only whooshes.
### Vi
- Vault Breaker (Q): the aim strip grows with the windup to show how far she'll dash.
- Relentless Force (E): a smoke blast shows the champs behind the target getting shoved.
## Interface
- The mouse stays inside the game window during matches, with a new crosshair cursor (Esc frees it).
*Everyone needs 1.8.0 to play together.*

## Maps
- Incinerator: darker room lit by the pit, steady warm light over the whole stage, embers rising from the pit.
- The pit glows evenly to its edges; bloom stays tight around it.
## Interface
- Much less bloom on players (eyes, champion glows, shiny highlights).
- The team belt only shows in team matches.
- The update screen shows the new version number while downloading.

## Gameplay
- Aim with your mouse: hold Q or E to aim Rocket Grab, Devastating Charge or Vault Breaker at your cursor (only you see the aim line), then let go to cast.
## Maps
- Incinerator: you no longer spawn over the pit; the conveyor belts slowly roll you toward the fire; the pit glows and spits lava, and its firelight lights up the room.
- Shadows and bloom are closer to Gang Beasts' on every stage.

## Fixes
- 1.6.0's menu not responding and the missing game preview in the background (a file was missing from the installer).

## Champions
### Sett
- Haymaker shows its hit area while it charges.
## Gameplay
- Lift and throw: while grabbing someone, hold Shift (or click in the left stick) to lift them overhead, then let go to throw them.
- Climbing: while hanging from a ledge, hold jump to push yourself up, then push toward the ledge to roll over it.
- Ragdolls: limbs no longer fold through the body.
## Maps
- New stage: Incinerator. Ring and Lighthouse are removed.
- Gang Beasts' own map lighting.
## Interface
- Redesigned menus, lobby, HUD, pause and update screens, with a new crest logo.
- Quiet, subtle UI sounds; the menu music is gone.
- About 3x higher frame rate.

## Maps
- Three new maps from Gang Beasts: Rooftop, Ring and Lighthouse.
- Girders gained its grabbable bars.
## Online play
- Much less rubberbanding: the host no longer drops late inputs (fast moves like Hecarim's charge, and getting hit, now stay in sync), and corrections glide instead of snapping.
## Interface
- Abilities are back on Q / E, and every control can be rebound from the main menu (click a key, press the new one; Esc cancels, Backspace clears).
- Updates install and relaunch much faster (the game is now 20 files instead of ~1,900). This first update to 1.5.0 still has to remove the old files, so it is the slow one.

## Online play
- Smoother online play, especially for players who aren't hosting or have high ping.
- Your inputs now reach the host in a fixed order and timing, so your champion no longer gets pulled back (rubberbanding) when the connection is jittery.
- Other players move on the host's clock with a buffer that adapts to your connection, instead of stuttering when updates arrive unevenly.
- Motion is smooth on screens faster than 60Hz (host too).
- While knocked out or hooked you see your body exactly where the host has it, instead of it jerking around.

## Champions
### Sett
- Haymaker hits 50% harder.
### Hecarim
- Rampage spins once (half as long).
## Gameplay
- Controls now match Gang Beasts: each mouse button is one hand. Tap to punch with it, hold to reach out and grab with it (in the air a held hand grabs straight away, for ledges). J / K do the same.
- Abilities moved to **X** and **C**; lie down is **Left Ctrl**. On a gamepad the triggers/bumpers are your hands, X/Y abilities, B lie down, A jump, right stick click headbutt.
- Punches are a proper swing now: the arm cocks back, then hooks round while the shoulders turn into it, instead of shooting straight out. Arms no longer twist at the shoulder. Regular punches knock back less.
- Grabbing walls and other solid things no longer shoves you into the floor.

## Champions
### Hecarim
- Devastating Charge builds up speed instead of starting at full gallop, and hits harder the faster you're going. Press E again to stop it.
- Rampage now works while walking or mid-charge.
### Sett
- Haymaker (Q) is powered by Grit. Getting hit fills the bar over his head, and it drains out of combat. Hold Q to plant and charge, then let go for a cone punch as strong as the Grit you spent.
- Facebreaker shows its reach on the ground and stuns (longer if you catch champs on both sides).
- New vest.
### Blitzcrank
- Rocket Grab: a hooked champ goes limp and can't fight back until the pull ends.
## Gameplay
- Spawn points are random every round.
## Online play
- Less lag for high-ping players: your own champion moves and swings instantly on your screen; the host still decides hits and knockouts and your game quietly lines itself up with the host.
## Interface
- Holding Ctrl to lie down while pressing W no longer closes the game.
- Headbutt is now F or middle click (H still works).
- The cursor is hidden during matches unless the Esc menu is open.

## Online play
- Relay fallback for players who can't connect directly (strict NAT, mainland China): joining tries a direct connection, then switches to a relay server if that fails.
- Tick **Use relay** in the menu to skip the direct attempt and join through the relay straight away.
- Network test now also checks the relay.

## Champions
### Vi (new)
- Vault Breaker (Q) and Relentless Force (E).
### Sett (new)
- Haymaker (Q) and Facebreaker (E).
## Gameplay
- 2.5s stun immunity after waking from a knockout.
## Online play
- Menu: Network test and Copy network log. If you can't connect, run the test, copy the log and send it over.
- Extra STUN servers that work from mainland China.

## Gameplay
- Climbing: hang with grab, Space to climb.
- Headbutt (H / pad B) and lie down (hold C / pad Y).
- Loose Gang Beasts-style arms that fling when you spin.
- Momentum punches: hold punch to keep the arm out.
- Hecarim hooves.
## Interface
- Volume slider and quieter sounds.

## Gameplay
- First release.
